label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Use a Clear Sender Name
body: Your subscribers should instantly know who the email is from, building trust and encouraging opens.
caption:
When your emails land in the inbox, your sender name is one of the first things people see. Make it easy for your audience to recognize you right away. Using your business name or your personal name (if you're the face of your brand) helps build familiarity and trust.
